jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Accelerate your success at Colliers.

Why Colliers?

As one of Canada’s leading commercial real estate services firms, we are driven by our mission to accelerate success for our people, clients, and communities.

A career at Colliers gives you the opportunity to make an impact, advance your career, and collaborate with top-tier talent. Don’t just take our word for it – we’ve been recognized as a top employer on a number of prestigious lists, including Best Workplaces in Canada, Best Workplaces with Most Trusted Executive Teams, among others.

Toronto, ON, Hybrid

About The Role

As Director, Data Engineering within our Global Technology & Data Team, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and executing Colliers' enterprise data engineering strategy across a complex multi-cloud environment. Partnering closely with data leadership, enterprise architecture, and technology stakeholders, you will lead the design, delivery, and operation of scalable data platforms and services that enable business transformation, advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and data-driven decision making across North America and globally.

This is an opportunity to leverage your expertise to help drive Colliers' next-generation data ecosystem, modernize our enterprise data platforms, and position the organization for continued innovation and growth.

Lead enterprise data engineering strategy: Direct and scale a high-performing team of managers and data engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.
Drive modern data platform delivery: Oversee the design, development, and implementation of enterprise-scale data platforms, including microservices architectures, data mesh and data fabric capabilities, AI/ML pipelines, Agentic AI and GenAI workflows, document extraction services, and business intelligence solutions.
Champion technology roadmap and innovation: Partner with Enterprise Architecture, product leaders, vendors, and technology stakeholders to define and execute the long-term data engineering roadmap, ensuring alignment with regional and global business objectives.
Establish operational excellence and DataOps practices: Define and enforce standards for DataOps, SDLC, CI/CD, data governance, security, documentation, code quality, and AI-enabled delivery methodologies to ensure scalable and reliable platform operations.
Ensure platform reliability and service excellence: Oversee the operational health, performance, and support of critical North American and global data products, driving incident management, platform availability, and adherence to enterprise service level agreements (SLAs).

What You Bring

Degree and/or diploma in: Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Master’s degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
8-10 years of progressive experience, preferably in: data engineering, data platform, cloud engineering, enterprise data architecture, or related technology leadership roles, including experience managing managers and technical professionals.
Proven experience in cloud-based data architecture and engineering: Deep expertise designing and scaling enterprise data platforms using Google Cloud Platform services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataproc, Cloud Data Fusion, Cloud Run, and Apigee.
Strong proficiency in modern engineering practices and tools: Experience with Kubernetes, particularly GKE, microservices architecture, enterprise APIs, serverless computing, infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD frameworks.
Strategic understanding of BI, analytics, and artificial intelligence: Knowledge of semantic data models, Looker, Power BI, machine learning pipelines, and AI-driven solutions that accelerate engineering delivery and operational excellence.
Exceptional leadership and communication skills: Ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional teams, translate technical strategy into measurable business outcomes, and build a strong culture of accountability and collaboration.
Commercial real estate industry experience: Considered an asset.

This posting is for an existing vacancy within our organization.

Colliers does not use AI-enabled tools to sort or decline applications. All decisions are made by our talent acquisition team.

What We Offer

Innovative projects:
Work on cutting-edge initiatives that shape our communities, drive our growth, and make a tangible impact.

Career growth:
Advance your career and achieve your goals with industry-leading training and development programs.

Competitive benefits & compensation:
Enjoy a comprehensive and flexible benefits package along with competitive compensation that rewards your contributions and supports your well-being.

Collaborative culture:
Join our enterprising team where innovation thrives, collaboration is key, and our people are empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion:
Our robust North American Diversity & Inclusion Program features eight Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), where you can connect, learn, and contribute to a diverse and supportive community. Learn more: https://www.collierscanada.com/en-ca/careers/diversity-and-inclusion

Global network
: Join a global team of 28,000 professionals across 70 countries, where you'll expand your network and learn from experts in a dynamic international community. Accelerate your career and enhance your expertise as you connect and collaborate with top talent around the world.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in Canada on a full-time basis. The employer will not sponsor applicants for work visas.

Direct applicants only please, no agencies.

Colliers is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in its workforce. Colliers encourages applications from all qualified individuals and will accommodate applicants' disability-related needs, up to the point of undue hardship, throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. If you require a disability-related accommodation to participate in the recruitment process, please contact the recruitment team by email at careers@colliers.com.

Senior Vice President, Finance
jobs.description:
Agency

Weber Shandwick

Job Function

Finance

Job Subfunction

Finance Management

Job Description

We are seeking an SVP, Finance to serve as a strategic business partner to agency leadership and provide financial and operational leadership across Omnicom Public Relations, Canada, consisting of Weber Shandwick, Golin Ketchum, FleishmanHillard and Porter Novelli. The successful candidate will be a results-driven, collaborative leader who brings strong financial acumen, sound judgement to support business decisions and drive performance. The role leads the finance team and will report to the CEO, OPR Canada and Mexico, and the CFO, Golin Ketchum. This position is based in Toronto and follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation of working in the office three days per week.

Key Responsibilities

Provide leadership, mentorship and counsel to the finance team, building a high-performing function with strong individual development.
Provide counsel to the Managing Director, CFO, CEO and senior leaders on the financial and operational performance of the business.
Oversee the budget and forecasting processes to continually assess the state of the business, and report findings in a complete, timely and accurate manner.
Drive the dissemination, review, understanding and usage of financial information across the business to support decision making.
Drive financial performance through analysis of staff utilization, client profitability, working capital management (WIP and A/R), cash forecasting, and other key metrics, identifying opportunities and risk.
Partner with CFO and leadership on client compensation planning, staffing models, utilization/billability, operations management and other matters impacting business performance.
Drive effective month and quarter-end close processes.
Ensure billing is completed accurately and on time, and support initiatives to improve the cycle and client billing efficiencies.
Identify cost savings measures where appropriate. Act as primary finance approver on non-billable expenses, oversee client-billable spending, and ensure vendor integrity.
Work with others (FDs, MDs, CFO, Exec team, Community and Practice leaders) on large RFP responses when appropriate.
Work with HR on workforce planning and staffing needs, including resource planning and related compensation considerations.
Consult with Business Affairs team (Legal) on contract and client matters including the review and negotiation of compensation and contract terms.
Support all agency and parent company policies and procedures and collaborate internally and across other agencies to share knowledge and ensure best practices.

Required Skills

Leadership and Management skills to include: Problem solving, decision making, time management, strategic thinking, interpersonal communications, written and consultative communications, organization, partnership, mentorship, personal development (own and others), self-starter and self-guided.
Client service skills to include: Team player attitude, commitment, patience, enthusiasm, creativity, comprehension, initiative, cooperation, attention to detail, resourcefulness.
Professionalism to include: Confidence, good judgment, appropriate demeanor and appearance, ability to interact with all levels of employees and clients.
General accounting: theory, practice, procedures and policies.

Qualifications

15+ total years of experience, with increasing levels of responsibilities and portfolio.
Experience leading a finance function within a complex, evolving business environment.
Direct experience working with key leaders and managing staff.
Experience in the communications industry (Public Relations, Advertising, Digital, Marketing, etc.), consulting or other similar service companies a plus.
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business or related field is required.

Salary Range: $190,000 to 225,000 CAD

Weber Shandwick is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. Weber Shandwick recruits qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, age, ethnic or national origin, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status or citizenship status.

$190,000 to 225,000 CAD

Omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager. Our objective is to increase this requirement over time, and many of our agencies as well as Omnicom’s corporate group already require five days of in-office attendance.

Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Link to Recruitment Privacy Notice: https://www.omc.com/privacy-notice/

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
Company Description
Mazda Gaspé is an automotive dealership focused on delivering reliable vehicles and responsive customer service. The organization values transparency, operational efficiency, and sustainable business practices across sales, service, and financing activities. Team members collaborate to create a positive experience for clients while maintaining strong financial and operational performance. The company supports modern work practices, including remote collaboration, and encourages continuous improvement in all areas of the business.
Role Description
The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) at Mazda Gaspé is a part-time, remote role responsible for overseeing the company’s overall financial strategy and performance. The CFO will manage budgeting and forecasting, monitor cash flow, and provide financial guidance to leadership to support decision-making and long-term growth. Daily tasks include reviewing financial statements, ensuring accurate financial reporting, and maintaining compliance with relevant accounting standards and regulations. The CFO will collaborate with internal teams and external partners to optimize financial processes, analyze risks and opportunities, and implement controls that support sustainable profitability. This role also involves preparing regular financial updates for management, advising on investments and capital allocation, and supporting strategic initiatives.
Qualifications

Strong foundation in Finance, with demonstrated experience in corporate or dealership financial management.
MUST BE LOCATED IN CANADA
Proficiency in Financial Planning and budgeting, including forecasting and cash flow management.
Ability to prepare, interpret, and review Financial Statements, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Experience in Financial Reporting, including management reports and regulatory filings.
Advanced Analytical Skills, with the ability to assess financial performance and identify trends and risks.
Comfort with remote work tools, strong communication skills, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Experience in the automotive or retail sector is an asset.
Relevant academic background in finance, accounting, or business; professional designations (e.g., CPA, CFA) are an advantage.

jobs.title: Director, Strategy & Business Development
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Director, Strategy and Business Development, will be responsible for contributing to growing Seaspan Shipyards business by leading and implementing business strategies for new or growing markets. Interfacing with Seaspan’s senior leadership team, this role will lead and support a range of strategic plans and initiatives including broad new business strategies, transformational initiatives, strategic initiatives and complex captures.

Key to this role will be a strategic approach to understanding the breadth and complexity of our customer’s needs and developing strategies and solutions to meet those needs – both technical and non-technical. Working as part of the broader multi-disciplinary Seaspan team, this role will include direct leadership of strategic initiative teams collaborative interfaces to many other departments and teams within Seaspan. An important aspect of this role will be the development of business cases for our strategic initiatives including how they will generate long-term returns for Seaspan.

Note: This position qualifies for an optional hybrid work schedule after 90 days of onsite work and onboarding. Employee will be subject to the terms of the Flexible Work Policy Agreement.

What You'll Do

Drive future growth for the company through disciplined but creative strategy and business development.
Lead development and implementation of new business strategies targeting new or growing markets.
Lead implementation of strategic initiatives
Provide oversight, guidance and support to capture leads and their capture and proposal teams.
Lead activities to find and develop opportunities both with new potential customers and with existing customers.
Maintain key business development contacts with current and potential customers.
Build and lead capture teams and proposal teams as required for each approved opportunity.
Identify growth opportunities within international markets and work with the wider Seaspan organization to develop competitive export offerings.
Represent and advocate on behalf of Seaspan Shipyards at conferences, trades shows, and other industry events.
Interface with other departments and teams in the Seaspan organization to achieve objectives in a manner aligned with overall Seaspan priorities, strategies and processes.
Strong communication skills (verbal and written) with customers, partners, suppliers and within Seaspan.

What You'll Bring

10+ years of professional industry experience advancing complex new business development strategies and bid proposals in the shipbuilding industry or in a complex defence, aerospace or systems development, manufacturing or construction industry.
University degree in a relevant area preferred.
Proven track record of developing business strategies and then leading the implementation.
Experience leading and closing complex opportunities with contract values over $10M and ideally over $50M.
Broad understanding of technical, programmatic, financial and commercial aspects of complex deals.
Experience with forming and maintaining strategic industry partnerships and supplier arrangements as part of an overall strategy.
This job is both strategic and tactical, and requires substantial leadership in market/customer strategy and opportunity capture.
Multi-faceted leadership skills applicable to direct leadership roles and influential leadership roles.
Ability to work in a highly flexible and fluid environment and maintain calm and rational thinking and reasoning at all times.
Demonstrated ability to communicate with a variety of stakeholders and the ability to respond to stakeholder needs strategically and tactfully.
Exceptional interpersonal skills, superior oral and written capabilities, including the ability to build professional relationships with government and industry partners.
Skilled at advocacy, influence, and persuasion, with the able to convince others to act on information or recommendations based on compelling logic or common best interests.
Knowledge of complex government markets.
Strong knowledge and expertise with Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word, Project and Excel).
Self-starter with good organizational skills who can work both independently and as a member of a team.

Why you'll love working here

This is a full-time, permanent position. With multiple operations and long-term projects, Seaspan employees enjoy job stability as we look ahead to build ships for decades to come.
In addition to an annual bonus and pension plan matching, this role provides you a very competitive salary in line with the successful candidate’s experience.
We also provide a best-in-class health and wellness benefits package for this position, including such things as full health care (e.g. unlimited physiotherapy), dental, vision, life insurance, medical leave coverage, parental leave coverage, wellness/fitness reimbursement for memberships or registration fees, and an Employee Family Assistance Program (EFAP).
This position qualifies for an optional hybrid work schedule.
Parking is included and to assist those that are using transit, we operate a complimentary shuttle bus Monday through Friday with various pick up and drop off points around North Vancouver.

The estimated salary for this position is $180,000 - $220,000. In determining final salary, Seaspan considers many factors including the successful Candidate’s skills and experience as well as position location and internal equity. The final base salary offer will be at the Company’s sole discretion and presented as part of a competitive total compensation package.

About Us

Seaspan Shipyards is one of North America’s most modern shipyards and unique in its ability to provide a complete range of services including new construction, conversion, refit, repair and life-cycle maintenance work for Canada’s Coast Guard and Navy as well as commercial vessels including cruise-ships and deep-sea vessels. Seaspan Shipyards operations include Vancouver Shipyards, Vancouver Drydock and Victoria Shipyards.

To learn more, visit our website:
www.seaspan.com

This position may involve defense articles and/or technical data regulated by the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (“ITAR”) and the U.S. Arms Export Control Act. In compliance with ITAR, the successful candidate will be subject to a security clearance through the Canadian Controlled Goods Program as regulated by the Controlled Goods Regulations and Defense Production Act. The successful candidate will be required to maintain their security clearance throughout their employment in this position.

Seaspan is committed to Employment Equity, supports diversity in the workplace, and encourages applications from all qualified individuals including, women, members of visible minorities, Indigenous persons, and persons with disabilities. If you require any accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruit@seaspan.com for confidential support. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales
jobs.description:
About The Job

The Director of Enterprise Sales is responsible for driving revenue growth, customer acquisition, and strategic account expansion within the enterprise customer segment. This role develops and executes enterprise sales strategies, leads a team of enterprise sales professionals, and builds relationships with senior customer stakeholders to secure complex, high-value business opportunities.

The Director oversees the enterprise sales pipeline, manages strategic deal execution, and ensures alignment between customer business needs and the organization's products and services. Working cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success, the Director drives sales performance, strengthens customer relationships, and achieves revenue and profitability objectives.

What You Will Do

Enterprise Sales Strategy and Revenue Growth

Develop and execute enterprise sales strategies to achieve revenue, new customer acquisition, and account expansion targets.
Identify and prioritize enterprise prospects based on market opportunity, customer potential, and strategic fit.
Drive new business development and expansion opportunities across large, complex customer organizations.
Establish sales plans, pipeline coverage targets, and account prioritization strategies.
Develop strategies to penetrate new enterprise accounts and increase share of wallet within existing customers.

Strategic Account and Customer Relationship Management

Build trusted relationships with senior executives, business leaders, and key decision-makers within enterprise accounts.
Guide account planning and opportunity development for high-value customers.
Support complex negotiations, commercial proposals, and contract discussions.
Ensure sales strategies address customer business objectives, procurement requirements, and stakeholder priorities.
Partner with Customer Success to support retention, renewals, and account growth where applicable.

Sales Leadership and Execution

Lead, coach, and develop enterprise account executives and sales managers.
Establish clear sales targets, performance expectations, and accountability measures.
Provide guidance on enterprise sales methodologies, deal qualification, negotiation, and closing strategies.
Lead pipeline reviews, opportunity assessments, and sales forecasting activities.
Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, customer focus, and performance excellence.

Complex Deal Management

Oversee strategic opportunities involving multiple stakeholders, lengthy sales cycles, and significant contract values.
Coordinate internal resources to develop customer-specific solutions and proposals.
Partner with Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Finance, and Procurement teams to address complex deal requirements.
Support pricing strategy, commercial structuring, and contract negotiations within delegated authority.

Performance and Cross-Functional Collaboration

Monitor revenue attainment, pipeline health, conversion rates, win rates, and forecast accuracy.
Analyze enterprise market trends, competitive positioning, and customer buying behavior.
Collaborate with Marketing and Business Development to strengthen enterprise lead generation and pipeline development.
Partner with Customer Success and Delivery teams to support successful customer onboarding and long-term value realization.

What You Will Bring

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
Typically 8–12+ years of B2B sales experience, including significant enterprise sales leadership.
Proven track record of achieving enterprise revenue targets and closing complex, high-value deals.
Experience managing enterprise account executives, sales managers, or strategic account teams.
Strong understanding of enterprise buying processes, executive stakeholder management, procurement, and commercial negotiations.
Demonstrated proficiency in pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and CRM systems.
Excellent executive communication, negotiation, coaching, and relationship-building skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Enterprise new business revenue and quota attainment.
Strategic account growth and expansion revenue.
Enterprise pipeline coverage and conversion rates.
Win rate and average deal size.
Forecast accuracy and sales cycle effectiveness.
Customer retention and renewal performance, where applicable.
Sales team productivity and quota attainment

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Inclusion at Red Hat

Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

new_jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
new_jobs.description:
Company Description
Mazda Gaspé is an automotive dealership focused on delivering reliable vehicles and responsive customer service. The organization values transparency, operational efficiency, and sustainable business practices across sales, service, and financing activities. Team members collaborate to create a positive experience for clients while maintaining strong financial and operational performance. The company supports modern work practices, including remote collaboration, and encourages continuous improvement in all areas of the business.
Role Description
The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) at Mazda Gaspé is a part-time, remote role responsible for overseeing the company’s overall financial strategy and performance. The CFO will manage budgeting and forecasting, monitor cash flow, and provide financial guidance to leadership to support decision-making and long-term growth. Daily tasks include reviewing financial statements, ensuring accurate financial reporting, and maintaining compliance with relevant accounting standards and regulations. The CFO will collaborate with internal teams and external partners to optimize financial processes, analyze risks and opportunities, and implement controls that support sustainable profitability. This role also involves preparing regular financial updates for management, advising on investments and capital allocation, and supporting strategic initiatives.
Qualifications

Strong foundation in Finance, with demonstrated experience in corporate or dealership financial management.
MUST BE LOCATED IN CANADA
Proficiency in Financial Planning and budgeting, including forecasting and cash flow management.
Ability to prepare, interpret, and review Financial Statements, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Experience in Financial Reporting, including management reports and regulatory filings.
Advanced Analytical Skills, with the ability to assess financial performance and identify trends and risks.
Comfort with remote work tools, strong communication skills, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Experience in the automotive or retail sector is an asset.
Relevant academic background in finance, accounting, or business; professional designations (e.g., CPA, CFA) are an advantage.

new_jobs.title: Director, Strategy & Business Development
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The Director, Strategy and Business Development, will be responsible for contributing to growing Seaspan Shipyards business by leading and implementing business strategies for new or growing markets. Interfacing with Seaspan’s senior leadership team, this role will lead and support a range of strategic plans and initiatives including broad new business strategies, transformational initiatives, strategic initiatives and complex captures.

Key to this role will be a strategic approach to understanding the breadth and complexity of our customer’s needs and developing strategies and solutions to meet those needs – both technical and non-technical. Working as part of the broader multi-disciplinary Seaspan team, this role will include direct leadership of strategic initiative teams collaborative interfaces to many other departments and teams within Seaspan. An important aspect of this role will be the development of business cases for our strategic initiatives including how they will generate long-term returns for Seaspan.

Note: This position qualifies for an optional hybrid work schedule after 90 days of onsite work and onboarding. Employee will be subject to the terms of the Flexible Work Policy Agreement.

What You'll Do

Drive future growth for the company through disciplined but creative strategy and business development.
Lead development and implementation of new business strategies targeting new or growing markets.
Lead implementation of strategic initiatives
Provide oversight, guidance and support to capture leads and their capture and proposal teams.
Lead activities to find and develop opportunities both with new potential customers and with existing customers.
Maintain key business development contacts with current and potential customers.
Build and lead capture teams and proposal teams as required for each approved opportunity.
Identify growth opportunities within international markets and work with the wider Seaspan organization to develop competitive export offerings.
Represent and advocate on behalf of Seaspan Shipyards at conferences, trades shows, and other industry events.
Interface with other departments and teams in the Seaspan organization to achieve objectives in a manner aligned with overall Seaspan priorities, strategies and processes.
Strong communication skills (verbal and written) with customers, partners, suppliers and within Seaspan.

What You'll Bring

10+ years of professional industry experience advancing complex new business development strategies and bid proposals in the shipbuilding industry or in a complex defence, aerospace or systems development, manufacturing or construction industry.
University degree in a relevant area preferred.
Proven track record of developing business strategies and then leading the implementation.
Experience leading and closing complex opportunities with contract values over $10M and ideally over $50M.
Broad understanding of technical, programmatic, financial and commercial aspects of complex deals.
Experience with forming and maintaining strategic industry partnerships and supplier arrangements as part of an overall strategy.
This job is both strategic and tactical, and requires substantial leadership in market/customer strategy and opportunity capture.
Multi-faceted leadership skills applicable to direct leadership roles and influential leadership roles.
Ability to work in a highly flexible and fluid environment and maintain calm and rational thinking and reasoning at all times.
Demonstrated ability to communicate with a variety of stakeholders and the ability to respond to stakeholder needs strategically and tactfully.
Exceptional interpersonal skills, superior oral and written capabilities, including the ability to build professional relationships with government and industry partners.
Skilled at advocacy, influence, and persuasion, with the able to convince others to act on information or recommendations based on compelling logic or common best interests.
Knowledge of complex government markets.
Strong knowledge and expertise with Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word, Project and Excel).
Self-starter with good organizational skills who can work both independently and as a member of a team.

Why you'll love working here

This is a full-time, permanent position. With multiple operations and long-term projects, Seaspan employees enjoy job stability as we look ahead to build ships for decades to come.
In addition to an annual bonus and pension plan matching, this role provides you a very competitive salary in line with the successful candidate’s experience.
We also provide a best-in-class health and wellness benefits package for this position, including such things as full health care (e.g. unlimited physiotherapy), dental, vision, life insurance, medical leave coverage, parental leave coverage, wellness/fitness reimbursement for memberships or registration fees, and an Employee Family Assistance Program (EFAP).
This position qualifies for an optional hybrid work schedule.
Parking is included and to assist those that are using transit, we operate a complimentary shuttle bus Monday through Friday with various pick up and drop off points around North Vancouver.

The estimated salary for this position is $180,000 - $220,000. In determining final salary, Seaspan considers many factors including the successful Candidate’s skills and experience as well as position location and internal equity. The final base salary offer will be at the Company’s sole discretion and presented as part of a competitive total compensation package.

About Us

Seaspan Shipyards is one of North America’s most modern shipyards and unique in its ability to provide a complete range of services including new construction, conversion, refit, repair and life-cycle maintenance work for Canada’s Coast Guard and Navy as well as commercial vessels including cruise-ships and deep-sea vessels. Seaspan Shipyards operations include Vancouver Shipyards, Vancouver Drydock and Victoria Shipyards.

To learn more, visit our website:
www.seaspan.com

This position may involve defense articles and/or technical data regulated by the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (“ITAR”) and the U.S. Arms Export Control Act. In compliance with ITAR, the successful candidate will be subject to a security clearance through the Canadian Controlled Goods Program as regulated by the Controlled Goods Regulations and Defense Production Act. The successful candidate will be required to maintain their security clearance throughout their employment in this position.

Seaspan is committed to Employment Equity, supports diversity in the workplace, and encourages applications from all qualified individuals including, women, members of visible minorities, Indigenous persons, and persons with disabilities. If you require any accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruit@seaspan.com for confidential support. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment.

new_jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales
new_jobs.description:
About The Job

The Director of Enterprise Sales is responsible for driving revenue growth, customer acquisition, and strategic account expansion within the enterprise customer segment. This role develops and executes enterprise sales strategies, leads a team of enterprise sales professionals, and builds relationships with senior customer stakeholders to secure complex, high-value business opportunities.

The Director oversees the enterprise sales pipeline, manages strategic deal execution, and ensures alignment between customer business needs and the organization's products and services. Working cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success, the Director drives sales performance, strengthens customer relationships, and achieves revenue and profitability objectives.

What You Will Do

Enterprise Sales Strategy and Revenue Growth

Develop and execute enterprise sales strategies to achieve revenue, new customer acquisition, and account expansion targets.
Identify and prioritize enterprise prospects based on market opportunity, customer potential, and strategic fit.
Drive new business development and expansion opportunities across large, complex customer organizations.
Establish sales plans, pipeline coverage targets, and account prioritization strategies.
Develop strategies to penetrate new enterprise accounts and increase share of wallet within existing customers.

Strategic Account and Customer Relationship Management

Build trusted relationships with senior executives, business leaders, and key decision-makers within enterprise accounts.
Guide account planning and opportunity development for high-value customers.
Support complex negotiations, commercial proposals, and contract discussions.
Ensure sales strategies address customer business objectives, procurement requirements, and stakeholder priorities.
Partner with Customer Success to support retention, renewals, and account growth where applicable.

Sales Leadership and Execution

Lead, coach, and develop enterprise account executives and sales managers.
Establish clear sales targets, performance expectations, and accountability measures.
Provide guidance on enterprise sales methodologies, deal qualification, negotiation, and closing strategies.
Lead pipeline reviews, opportunity assessments, and sales forecasting activities.
Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, customer focus, and performance excellence.

Complex Deal Management

Oversee strategic opportunities involving multiple stakeholders, lengthy sales cycles, and significant contract values.
Coordinate internal resources to develop customer-specific solutions and proposals.
Partner with Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Finance, and Procurement teams to address complex deal requirements.
Support pricing strategy, commercial structuring, and contract negotiations within delegated authority.

Performance and Cross-Functional Collaboration

Monitor revenue attainment, pipeline health, conversion rates, win rates, and forecast accuracy.
Analyze enterprise market trends, competitive positioning, and customer buying behavior.
Collaborate with Marketing and Business Development to strengthen enterprise lead generation and pipeline development.
Partner with Customer Success and Delivery teams to support successful customer onboarding and long-term value realization.

What You Will Bring

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
Typically 8–12+ years of B2B sales experience, including significant enterprise sales leadership.
Proven track record of achieving enterprise revenue targets and closing complex, high-value deals.
Experience managing enterprise account executives, sales managers, or strategic account teams.
Strong understanding of enterprise buying processes, executive stakeholder management, procurement, and commercial negotiations.
Demonstrated proficiency in pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and CRM systems.
Excellent executive communication, negotiation, coaching, and relationship-building skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Enterprise new business revenue and quota attainment.
Strategic account growth and expansion revenue.
Enterprise pipeline coverage and conversion rates.
Win rate and average deal size.
Forecast accuracy and sales cycle effectiveness.
Customer retention and renewal performance, where applicable.
Sales team productivity and quota attainment

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Inclusion at Red Hat

Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
